info.title: Stella IT Console API V2
info.description:
Cloud instance management API.

API keys use `Authorization: Bearer sk_<64 lowercase hex characters>`.
The full secret is returned only when issued. Never put an API key in a URL or Basic authentication.
Each operation's `x-api-key-scopes` lists all required scopes; scopes are independent.
Operations without this extension reject API keys, including key management.
An empty scope list permits any valid key. Automatically generated HEAD routes require the same scopes as GET,
including GET/HEAD power and payment actions. Existing ownership, visibility and user-action restrictions also apply.
API keys can access only orders requested by the key owner. Revocation, expiry and user bans apply to subsequent
requests and new WebSocket connections; active requests and connections are not interrupted.
Browser VNC continues to use the existing login authentication.

bearerAuth.description: OAuth access token or an API key on operations declaring x-api-key-scopes. Example header - Authorization Bearer sk_<64 lowercase hex characters>.

ApiKeyScope.description:
catalog:read - accessible public plans, images, nodes, regions, lineups and extras.
users:read - own profile and notification settings; users:write - own notification changes.
instances:read - own instances, status, metrics, tasks, owners, extras, DDoS history and ordinary guest information.
instances:write - own name, auto-renewal settings and static IP migration.
instances:power - start, shutdown, force stop, reset and reboot.
instances:reinstall - operating system reinstall.
instances:credentials:read - login credentials; instances:credentials:write - password reset.
instances:console - VNC tickets and WebSocket connections.
orders:read - own orders; orders:write - creation, renewal and credit top-up orders, and legacy renewal requests.
credits:read - own credit balance and ledger.
payments:write - billing charges, credit payments and manual payment URLs.
No scope implies any other scope. API keys operate within the owner's regular user permissions.

ApiKey.description: Key metadata without the original secret or stored authentication data.

createdBySub.description: Issuing user's subject, or null when unavailable.

expiresAt.description: Future timestamp with timezone. Omit or use null for no expiry.

key.description: One-time secret. Store securely; it cannot be retrieved later.

allOf.description: Additional fields returned when the full query parameter is present and nonempty. Image, plan and price are omitted when unavailable.

config.description: Plan configuration JSON; its structure depends on the node type.

serviceStatus.description: Failed or interrupted creation is not retried automatically; review the order before recovery.

amount.description: Signed integer credits. One credit equals one KRW.

nextCursor.description: Pass this ledger UUID as cursor for the next page, ordered by descending createdAt and then ID.

allOf.description: Authenticated identity claims with the server-controlled credit top-up permission.

ApiKeyList.description: All keys including expired and revoked keys, newest first.

ApiKeyIssued.description: Key issued; the secret is shown only in this response.

ApiKeyRevoked.description: Revoked key metadata. Repeated revocation preserves revokedAt and succeeds.

ApiKeyError.description: Invalid input (400), authentication or permission failure (403), or user/key not found (404). Keys belonging to other users return 404.

ScopedOperation.description: Successful operation; existing resource permissions also apply.

UnsupportedInstance.description: Operation is unsupported for this instance type.

get.summary: Charge the user's billing payment method
get.description:
This GET performs a billing charge; it is not a payment-options lookup.
Successful payment fulfills the service order. CREDIT_TOPUP is rejected.

200.description: Billing result. Success returns available instance fields and billedAmount; failure returns the upstream billing response with billedAmount.

409.description: Already paid or conflicting payment method

410.description: Service resources are unavailable or the renewal instance is inaccessible

get.description: Supports CREDIT_TOPUP as a user-initiated single payment. Reuses the existing payment URL. Once issuance starts, credits and billing are blocked for this order.

get.description: Requires a user identity. Credits have no cash refund or automatic top-up API.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Ledger UUID returned as nextCursor; must identify an existing transaction for this user.

200.description: Balance and a page of immutable ledger entries; credit amounts are decimal strings and ledger IDs are UUIDs.

post.summary: Pay for instance creation or manual extension using credits
post.description: Debits the entire server-calculated order price from the order author's wallet exactly once. No fallback payment or automatic top-up. CREDIT_TOPUP and orders where external payment has started are rejected. Extension is committed with the debit; creation runs after payment. Repeated requests return the existing order and result without a second debit or creation.

200.description: Paid order and available result instance; check serviceStatus for processing or failure

400.description: Top-up orders cannot be paid with credits

402.description: insufficient_credit; no balance or order changes are committed

403.description: Forbidden or order has no owner

404.description: Order not found or belongs to another user

409.description: payment_conflict; another payment method has started

410.description: Service resources are unavailable or the renewal instance is inaccessible
